data.summary: Completed fresh observation probe E061 (supplement drug adulteration patterns). Explored multiple domains (FDA food/drug/device recalls, NHTSA vehicle complaints, CPSC recalls, USGS water data, NWS alerts, FAERS, Wikipedia revisions). Designed and ran E061 with predeclared kill gate: chloramphenicol recurrence across 4 firms exceeds gate but is already served by FDA import alerts/tainted-supplements database and is ingredient-supply-chain-level, not product-level. No consumer-facing tool opportunity. Fixed doc lint violations in pre-existing EXPERIMENTS/061-release-notes (split apidiff.py, exempted raw HTML captures). Committed and pushed all working-tree changes including concurrent sessions' work.
